domain_review: payloadBits_eq quantifies over every Nat word, start and width, with no wire validity, acceptance or bounded-word hypothesis.
For width<64, the computed shift=56-(start-1+width) is below 64 and shift+width≤64. Truncating an arbitrary-width word to UInt64 cannot discard any requested output bit.

The public shift never reaches64; both generic helper shift and mask width bounds are explicit in payloadWordBits_eq. UInt64 modulo 64 shift-count semantics are therefore handled rather than assumed absent.

Width 0 produces mask 0 and value 0; width 63 produces 2^63 - 1 as the mask without unsigned subtraction wrap; width 64 and all larger widths retain the original unbounded Nat division/modulo expression.
start 0 uses the same saturating start-1 as the frozen formula. Oversized starts use the same saturating final subtraction, yielding shift 0; neither is rejected or silently reinterpreted.

Zero words, words wider than 64/130 bits, fields ending exactly at bit 64, and unrestricted fallback widths are covered by the universal proofs. Four kernel witnesses additionally exercise widths 0/63/64 and the helper bit 64 boundary.
payloadBits_lt uses the exact mask upper bound and Nat.mod_lt for the fallback. It assumes no validity predicate and establishes checked runtime array/Fin indices for every natural argument.
live_binding_review: The existing Impl.payloadBits name is replaced in place. decodePayloadFields and payloadValue continue calling it; ADSB, CommB inference/raw records, standard/oracle semantics, JSON presentation and whole-message report callers still use these live definitions.

The three changes in Impl.CommB are erased proof terms in cbStandardThreat Fin constructors and cbDensityTableGet checked indexing; no alternate decoder, corpus key, cache or legacy payload-copy path is introduced.
Proofs.Decoder replaces its former definitional payload equality with funext plus the new universal payloadBits_eq; all downstream component equalities retain the actual Impl calls.
Proofs.CommBTables changes only its import and private verticalMagnitude proof, rewriting live extraction through the proved equality before the same Nat modulo identity.
Frozen direct CommB and whole-message adapters still reach Impl.decodeBDS, Impl.Semantics.commB and Impl.decode; the new helper is transitively on their live paths.
Impl.PayloadBits imports only Model.Types, which imports Std. Runtime mask/bound proofs use platform facts only; Spec.PayloadBits is imported exclusively by the new proof module.
